flexible_high_rebound_tpu.structural_purpose: High-elasticity urban mobility infrastructure. Flexible elastomer filaments demand precise, slower print speeds and low volumetric feed rates to prevent flexible filament bunching inside the direct-drive extruder gears. The solid 5-wall shell perimeter and 3% intentional flow over-extrusion fuse the negative Poisson's ratio internal structural nodes into a cohesive metamaterial framework, delivering maximum impact absorption and tire bead resistance without tearing.
